> 普通の会社員が出世する「かぶきもの思考」。組織で消耗せず、空気を読みながら飲まれないためのKindle本。

## Book

- Title: 飄々と生きろ
- Subtitle: 普通の会社員が出世する「かぶきもの思考」
- Format: Kindle ebook
- Theme: company-worker strategy, promotion, workplace survival, personal axis, kabukimono thinking

## Summary

『飄々と生きろ』 is a Japanese Kindle book about keeping one's axis while working inside an organization. It frames "kabukimono thinking" as a calm, strategic way to read the room without being consumed by it.
